name: Peanut-Coconut Chicken Curry with Zucchini, Tomato & Cauliflower Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Cut each cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a large bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp virgin coconut oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Once the chicken is done, add curry powder and coriander to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tbsp coriander, ground

instructions.primary_message: Add chopped veggies, coconut milk, peanut butter, sugar, fish sauce, and chili-garlic sauce to the pot; stir to combine the curry and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook until chicken and veggies are cooked through, and curry has thickened, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (398 ml) cans coconut milk
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp fish sauce
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: While the curry is cooking, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add riced cauliflower, water, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is soft, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp virgin coconut oil
⅓ cup water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the cauliflower rice is done, remove from heat, add cilantro, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice and curry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
